findings.title: Critical/high advisories persist in the dev dependency tree; `next` override is mis-scoped
evidence: package.json:75 — pnpm.overrides `next: ">=15.5.24 <16 || >=16.3.6"` (both halves present, 16.x line forced to the patched range)

findings.impact: A critical/high advisory reachable only through the dev toolchain (Storybook/Playwright/Chromatic) was previously invisible to CI. findings.title: Dependency and license policy `expires` dates are not enforced by the gates

findings.title: No automated unused/duplicate dependency check; lockfile carries 55 multi-version packages
evidence: grep for depcheck/dedupe across package.json, .github/workflows and scripts — no `pnpm dedupe --check` or depcheck gate exists (only scripts/generate-sbom.mjs:330 dedupes SBOM components)

pnpm-lock.yaml at 8d299b8d — 954 snapshot entries; 55 package names resolve to more than one version (e.g. @supabase/realtime-js 2.106.2/2.117.2, @types/react-dom 18.3.7/19.3.0, brace-expansion 1.1.21/5.0.12, ajv 6.15.0/8.20.0)

#### Scheduled full-history secret scan has no failure notification (P2, open)

- What is happening: the weekly security scan fails silently except for GitHub's default email to the workflow's last editor.
